Sample.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/7] Random regression analyses on longitudinal SIQ-Jr total score identified a statistically significant linear trend with time (F3,419=131.34; P=.001)

IPT.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/7] Specifically, fluoxetine with CBT (P=.02) proved statistically superior to placebo whereas fluoxetine (P=.36) alone and CBT alone (P=.76) did not.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/5] Despite the exclusion for high-risk suicidality, a substantial minority of patients endorsed at least some suicidal ideation at baseline.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/5] For CDRS-R suicide item No. 13, 27% of patients were defined as having at least minimal suicidal ideation (score of 2), with 2% endorsing severe ideation (score of 6). On the SIQ-Jr, 29% of patients attained a score of 31 or higher
